messages:
anya: quick check — ops + product want a firm stance on internal contract shape. I'm leaning toward schema-first (protobufs) for s2s, and an opinionated gateway that exposes REST for external consumers. who owns the gateway? how do we propagate quotas/traces?

sam: +1 on schema-first for core services. it avoids runtime mismatches. gateway ownership should be a platform team responsibility, imo.

ben: curious about the translation layer. do we keep one-to-one mapping or allow facade endpoints? i'd prefer a thin translation to avoid divergence.

anya: thin translation sounds good. main concerns: 1) auth & quota headers must be preserved, 2) error surface needs consistent mapping so clients can handle 4xx/5xx predictably.

leo: agreement on headers. propose we standardize on `X-Request-Id`, `X-Org`, `X-Quota-Key` and always forward. gateway should add `X-Gateway-Routing` for routing policy debug.

julie: does anyone worry about binary protos in internal queues? e.g., some infra teams want JSON logs for easier debugging.

ben: proto is fine for wire; gateway can emit a normalized JSON audit event for observability. keep runtime faster with proto, but offer tooling to view proto payloads decoded.

anya: rollout UX question — teams will want opt-in vs opt-out for proto-first. we should allow a transitional mode per service where both JSON and proto are supported for N weeks before cutover. annotate repo with `APIMIGRATION.md`.

sam: about quotas — we need deterministic mapping of external quota units to internal units. suggestion: each proto RPC has an annotation `quota_unit: tokens` and gateway consumes that to convert from per-request quotas.

leo: +1. also add a routing policy tag on RPCs like `routing: low-latency|batchable|fault-tolerant` so runtime can choose GPU/CPU pools.

anya: protos with annotations looks good — we can use options or a small YAML metadata file generated at build. who will own the proto linting rules? platform team?

ben: platform team should own linting and codegen. we'll add a CI check that fails PRs with missing annotations for quota/routing/error-mapping.

platform-bot: canary deploy started for proto-linter v0.9 -> eng-platform infra (canary: 5 services) :rocket:

sam: tiny nit — what about cross-team contracts? suggest a shared schema registry (git monorepo or proto registry service) with versioning and deprecation policy.

julie: agreed. deprecation policy should be: announce 2 weeks -> soft-deprecation (gateway rejects new clients) -> 4 weeks later hard remove. document in `APIGOVERNANCE.md`.

anya: next steps: 1) draft proto annotation RFC (quota/routing/error), 2) platform implements lint + codegen hook, 3) gateway owners get translation library + header forwarding, 4) rollout playbook for service teams. i'll draft the RFC by EOD and ping everyone for quick review.

ben: thanks — if you want i can sketch the lint rules this afternoon.

leo: i'll prototype the `X-Gateway-Routing` debug header and a small middleware to forward quota headers.

julie: i'll start the `APIGOVERNANCE.md` skeleton and put suggested timelines.

anya: awesome. tagging @sam and @ben for help on the proto->json audit event idea. thanks all :thumbsup:
